# shivhari.tech

> Shivhari Ananta Lokhande - delivery lead, Certified Scrum Master and Workiva (Wdesk, Wdata, DataPrep) specialist in Pune, India. Six years across IIT Bombay, Accenture, Deloitte, EY GDS and CES Ltd. Java/Spring Boot engineering roots. Open to forward deployed engineer, Workiva and Scrum Master engagements (retainer or SOW, NDA, free 30-minute discovery call).

## Key facts
- Current role: Delivery Lead / Lead Scrum Master for a Workiva-integrated financial reporting web app (US client, 17 engineers across US and India hours), via EY GDS then CES Ltd at the client's request.
- Results: sprint throughput 45 -> 54 points; commitment-to-delivery 78% -> 94%; ~30% faster delivery and ~20% less rework on a fixed-date Deloitte engagement; ~40% less manual effort at Accenture; 50+ Workiva API integrations; 20+ Wdata processing chains.
- Credentials: Certified Scrum Master (Scrum Alliance, 2025); Workiva Financial Reporting Solutions Specialization and Data Management Suite (2022); M.Tech CSE (2023); PMP in progress (2026).
- Tools: Azure DevOps, JIRA, Confluence, Miro, Workiva, Java, Spring Boot, microservices, REST, AWS, SQL.
- Location: Pune, Maharashtra, India. Works US and India hours.
